svg.aria-label: Endpoint against starting noise between two crescents: the exact map jumps from −4.86 to +4.86 at zero; DDIM and a fitted network are ramps
svg.text: ONE NUMBER BETWEEN TWO OPPOSITE CRESCENTS · WHERE EACH STARTING NOISE ENDS
network fitted to the exact ends
Computed by the lab. The student is a network with two hidden layers of 64 units, fitted by least squares to 200,000 exact endpoints.
Shaded band: closer to the midpoint than to either crescent.
